imageOcr.privacy: Images never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

prep.title: Image enhancement
prep.offHint: Recognizes the original image as is. Use only if enhancement makes results worse.
prep.grayHint: Grayscale + contrast boost, 2x upscale for small images, auto-invert dark backgrounds. Recommended for most images.
prep.binaryHint: Splits text and background into pure black and white (Otsu). Great for scans and screenshots; may struggle with shadowed photos.

cleanup.title: Text cleanup
cleanup.fixKoreanSpaces: Remove spurious spaces between Korean syllables (e.g. 대 한 민 국 → 대한민국)
cleanup.joinLines: Join line breaks within paragraphs (better for pasting)

imageOcr.rerunHint: Recognition starts as soon as you add an image. After changing language, enhancement or rotation, press Recognize again.
imageOcr.modelNote: Language data (a few MB per language) is downloaded only the first time, then cached in your browser for instant starts.
imageOcr.previewAlt: Preview of the image to recognize
imageOcr.staleHint: Settings changed since this result. Press Recognize again to update it.
imageOcr.lowWordsHint: Low-confidence words. Compare them with the yellow boxes on the image and fix as needed.
imageOcr.error: Recognition failed. Try another image or change the enhancement option.
imageOcr.title: Image OCR
imageOcr.description: Recognize and edit image text in order. Pause after the current file, retry failures, and keep previous successful manuscripts and new edits made during recognition. Copy current or all results, download TXT, or send text to read aloud.
imageOcr.uploadDragDrop: Drag & drop or click to upload (multiple allowed)
imageOcr.pasteHint: Paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V · drop anywhere on the page

features.title: Features
items: Recognize Korean, English, Japanese, and Simplified or Traditional Chinese
Rotation and image preparation, low-confidence word markers, and Korean spacing or line cleanup
Sequential image processing, pause after the current file, and retry failed files
Keep previous successful text after a failed rerun and preserve new edits made during recognition
Confirmation before replacing edited manuscripts through rerun, cleanup, or reset
Copy current or all results with manual recovery, download TXT, or transfer to read aloud
Recognition runs in the browser; engine and language data download when needed

tips.title: Tips
items: Compare recognized text with the source image and correct mistakes.
After changing language, preparation, or rotation, existing results show an earlier-settings notice. Choose Recognize again to apply new settings.
Edits made while recognition is running are not overwritten by the new result. Previous successful text remains available.
Cleanup can rebuild text from the original recognition result instead of your edits. Read the confirmation before continuing.
Preparation may take time on the first run or when stored language data is unavailable. Download and recognition speed depend on your environment.

whatIs.title: What is Image OCR (Text Extraction)?
whatIs.description: This tool recognizes image text in your browser and turns it into an editable manuscript. Choose Korean, English, Japanese, or Simplified/Traditional Chinese and process images one at a time. Pause after the current file, continue, or retry failures. A failed or delayed rerun preserves previous successful text and new edits made in the meantime. Images are not uploaded to a recognition server; engine and language data downloads are needed.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Select, drop, or paste images with Ctrl+V. Recognition starts in order with the selected languages.
Pause after this file holds subsequent files. Continue recognition resumes them. Retry failed files only keeps a paused queue paused until you continue.
Change language, preparation, or rotation, then choose Recognize again. Actions that replace edited manuscripts or clear all content require confirmation.
Compare low-confidence markers with the image and edit the result. New edits made during recognition are not overwritten.
Copy the current or all results, or download TXT. If automatic copying fails, open the full text to select it manually or retry.
Combined output uses manuscripts with results in the current list order, including previous successes for processing or failed items. A selected manuscript can also be transferred to read aloud.

items.q: Does a failed rerun remove my edited manuscript?
items.a: Previous successful results and edits are kept. Replacing an edited manuscript with new recognition requires confirmation, and new edits made while that recognition runs are still preserved.

The current file finishes, then subsequent files wait. Files added or retried while paused wait until you continue. Old results arriving after reset or leaving the page are not applied to the current manuscript.

items.q: Do language, preparation, or rotation changes replace existing results?
items.a: Existing results remain with an earlier-settings notice. Choose Recognize again to use the new settings. Cleanup that resets edited text requires separate confirmation.

items.q: What is included in Copy all or the combined TXT?
items.a: Current manuscripts from images with results are collected in list order. Previous successes are included for images still processing or whose latest attempt failed. Completely empty text produces a no-content notice.

items.q: What should I do when copying fails or a download notice appears?
items.a: If automatic copying fails, open the full text to select it manually or retry. Changes to input, selection, or another output action block late feedback from older requests. A TXT notice confirms a download request, not that your device finished saving the file.

items.q: Are images and results sent to a recognition server?
items.a: Recognition runs in your browser without uploading images or results to a recognition server. Engine and language data download when needed, so preparation may require a network connection. Copy or download needed manuscripts before reloading.

items.q: No text was found, or the result is wrong.
items.a: A successful recognition with no text is distinguished from a failure. Accuracy depends on the source text, background, angle, and other factors, so compare and correct the result. An empty new result does not overwrite an existing edited manuscript.

handoff.title: Listen to this text
handoff.hint: Review recognition errors, then send this page or the selected passage to TTS. Up to 30,000 characters, transferred within this tab without adding text to the URL.
handoff.storageFailed: Could not transfer text. Check browser storage or copy and paste it into TTS.

jobs.title: Recognition queue
jobs.pausing: The queue will pause after the current file finishes.
jobs.pauseHint: The current file finishes before the queue pauses. Files added while paused also wait until you choose Continue.
jobs.retryPaused: Failed files were added to the queue. Continue processes them in order with the other waiting files.
jobs.previousResult: Showing the previous successful result. Editing, copy, TXT and read-aloud transfer use this manuscript.
jobs.settingsChanged: This result used earlier language, preparation or rotation settings. Choose Recognize again to apply the current settings.
jobs.editedRetained: Recognition finished. Your edited manuscript has been kept.
jobs.emptyResult: Recognition finished, but no text was found.
jobs.emptyEditedRetained: No text was found in the new recognition. Your edited manuscript has been kept.
jobs.resourceWaiting: Finishing cleanup of an earlier recognition job. Waiting files will start when it is ready.
jobs.workerUnavailable: Could not prepare recognition. The previous manuscript has been kept. Try the failed files again.

confirmation.title: Review edited manuscripts
confirmation.rerun: Replace {count} edited manuscripts with new recognition results? Previous manuscripts are kept if recognition fails.
confirmation.cleanup: Clean up {count} edited manuscripts from the original recognition results? Your edits will be reset.
confirmation.reset: Clear all images and manuscripts? This also removes {count} edited manuscripts.
confirmation.newEditHint: New edits made while recognition is running will not be overwritten.
confirmation.changed: The manuscript or list changed while awaiting confirmation. Review the current content and choose the action again.

output.failed: Automatic copying failed for {label}. Open the full text to select it manually, or try again.
output.selectionFailed: Automatic selection failed. Press and hold the text above, or select it manually to copy.
output.downloadFailed: The text file download could not be requested. Select Download TXT to try again.
output.downloadStarted: The text file download was requested.
output.available: Combines text from {count} images with results, in their current order. Previous results are included for images being processed or whose latest attempt failed.
output.empty: There is no text to copy.
